title: Harnessing the Power of LLMs in Practice: A Survey on ChatGPT and Beyond
measurement_description: The paper evaluates Large Language Models' performance on knowledge-intensive tasks, using knowledge of Hindu mythology as an example. It also generally discusses fairness and bias issues in LLMs across demographic categories, including religion.
findings: The paper, in its survey of LLM capabilities, notes that on knowledge-intensive tasks from the Big-bench benchmark, such as 'Hindu_knowledge' which requires factual recall about Hindu mythology, some LLMs perform better than the average human. It also states more generally that LLMs are susceptible to fairness issues and performance disparities across religious groups.
